message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes around **6–7 hours** under normal conditions—about 383 miles (≈616 km) along I‑5. In heavy traffic or during rush hour, it could stretch closer to 8 hours or more. If you’re planning a trip, it’s wise to check real‑time traffic updates before you leave.
